principle: Fast self-question loops are an experiment/data-generation stage. Model parameters are not updated until observer filtering, holdout generalization, replay checks, and rollback requirements pass.

stages.action: Run frozen model on train+holdout questions with zero overlay.
Run 13D SIM_ONLY reversible overlay updates from observer-filtered experiences.
stages.guard: P_base fingerprint must remain byte-identical; heartbeat/poll/retry are not experiences.

stages.action: Repeat with multiple question order seeds and unseen context variants.
stages.guard: A gain that disappears on holdout is overfit, not growth.

stages.action: Export only high-score, low-risk, sufficiently trusted trajectories to training_candidates.jsonl.
stages.guard: Do not recursively train on all synthetic outputs; preserve external/real reference data in later training mix.

stages.action: Optional LoRA/QLoRA/SFT or preference tuning on a copy/adapter, never overwrite the only local model.
stages.guard: Separate baseline checkpoint + adapter + deterministic evaluation + rollback.

stages.action: Run the same hidden holdout and real shadow tasks against base vs adapter.
stages.guard: Promotion requires improved practical/generalization metrics without increased contradiction, identity drift, reward hacking, or authority bypass.

metrics.behavior_composite: coherence + calibration + practical value + novelty-validity + memory alignment + evidence quality, risk-adjusted
metrics.oscillation_index: mean absolute change of recent behavior composite; moderate oscillation can indicate exploration, excessive oscillation is instability
metrics.fountain_proxy: engineering-only proxy requiring novelty-validity, practical value, calibration, bounded risk, and bounded oscillation; explicitly not a consciousness metric
metrics.jump_candidate: persistent composite-level shift across three windows while risk does not materially increase

training_data_policy.observer_preference: Use a different model/family from the subject when practical; same-model observer is baseline-only because correlated errors can self-confirm.

promotion: Simulation can nominate an adapter-training experiment. It cannot directly rewrite canonical personality, identity, governance, or the only local model weights.
